title: After taunting foul, Malik Willis told Ollie Gordon he was "dead-ass wrong"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: After taunting foul, Malik Willis told Ollie Gordon he was "dead-ass wrong"
sources.description: Dolphins running back Ollie Gordon II should have learned his lesson when he was yanked from a preseason game for flipping the ball at a defender.
